original_test_intent: Verify that the BMC remote-console service remains connected to the correct managed system when host power is off and presents the platform-defined POWER OFF visual state rather than stale video, disconnection or another host's console.
original_method: Select the unique row; identify SUT/BMC/KVM firmware/client and prove console-to-host association; baseline host/BMC power, active jobs, current live KVM video and preserved logs; quiesce and execute the approved graceful shutdown or explicitly authorized hard-off; verify actual host power-off independently; launch a fresh KVM session, record Connected status, timestamped POWER OFF screen and session freshness, then close without sending input/power/media actions; restore the approved final power state and verify BMC/KVM health.
manual_activity: An authorized operator approves and controls host shutdown, launches the KVM, directly verifies Connected and POWER OFF on the correct host, and owns power restoration/recovery.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/KVM firmware/client and authenticated session identity
Approved graceful versus hard power-off method and actual-off oracle
Exact Connected status label and platform POWER OFF screen/graphic/text oracle
Fresh-session/stale-frame detection and acceptable display latency
Maintenance window, workload drain, final power state and recovery path
safety_requirements: Drain users/jobs and flush data before shutdown
Verify the exact BMC/SUT before any power action; prefer graceful shutdown unless hard-off is explicitly required
Protect credentials/session artifacts and prohibit unintended KVM keyboard/mouse, virtual-media, reset or power controls
Confirm the screen is fresh and correlated to actual power state rather than cached video
Stop on wrong host, shutdown failure, BMC/KVM loss, stale/frozen display or unexpected power behavior; no automatic retry/cycle
agent_execution_scope: Validate identity, power method, session/client, approval and recovery
Collect read-only power state and organize operator screenshot/session/BMC evidence
Assist fresh KVM launch after separately approved shutdown
Do not power off autonomously, claim visual sight, send input, use virtual media, clear logs, retry power or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve shutdown method, actual-off and KVM Connected/POWER OFF/freshness oracle
Approve session security, final state and recovery
Review synchronized power/KVM evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: IPMI may corroborate/perform an approved hard-off but is not unconditional permission and cannot prove the KVM screen. The source does not specify hard versus graceful shutdown.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approved host shutdown and independent off-state proof, launch a fresh authorized KVM session and record Connected plus the correct non-stale POWER OFF screen, then close safely.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Power-off, KVM launch, Connected status, POWER OFF screen and 10/5-minute estimate remain; shutdown/freshness details are added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Synchronize independent host-power evidence with a fresh KVM session's connection metadata and timestamped visual frame from the correct BMC/SUT.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds clean-shutdown choice, target association, stale-frame control, session security, no-input boundary and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: IPMI off status cannot prove console availability or display; a Connected label cannot prove correct/fresh POWER OFF video.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some KVM implementations retain the last framebuffer after host-off or show a BMC-generated overlay; engineering must identify which exact display is expected.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must decide whether POWER OFF is literal BMC-generated text/graphic or simply a blank/no-signal state. A cached last frame must not be accepted unless the specification explicitly defines it.
expected_evidence: Workload-drain/approval plus shutdown command/action, response and independent actual-off state
Timestamped screenshot/video of the exact approved POWER OFF state with no stale/wrong-host evidence
BMC/SEL/session events, restored final power/KVM health, recovery and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The unique source consistently requires KVM Connected plus POWER OFF while host is off. Shutdown semantics and visual freshness are missing prerequisites, not contradictory coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The power-off KVM objective is clear. Target, shutdown, client, screen oracle and recovery are supplyable inputs; hybrid execution remains approval-gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2223 Wistron-BMC Sanity-00006-V002: approve the exact SUT/BMC/KVM firmware/client and session-to-host identity, graceful versus hard power-off method and actual-off oracle, literal Connected status plus POWER OFF/blank/no-signal visual requirement, stale-frame/fresh-session detection and latency, credential/input/media restrictions, workload drain, final power state, stop conditions and BMC/KVM/console recovery.

review_improvement: Prevents an unapproved hard shutdown and false pass from Connected or stale video, while tying the physical/remote visual result to independent power and target evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: KVM connection is between the client and BMC, so it may remain Connected even though host video is absent; that is precisely the behavior being tested. Conversely, the client can display a cached last frame while power is off, so a screenshot must be linked to a fresh session and the platform-defined POWER OFF overlay. Power state and video are separate evidence channels. The power action is disruptive but the visual portion is operator-observed, making this a hybrid confirmation-gated case rather than MANUAL ONLY.
